class.name: GrpcCall
class.description: Created by [method GrpcClient.call_async]. The network exchange runs on a worker thread; messages and the final status are delivered on the main thread through signals. [codeblock] var call := client.call_async("/pkg.Service/Watch", bytes, {}, 0, true) call.message_received.connect(func(message): print(message)) await call.completed print(call.get_status()) [/codeblock]

method.name: cancel
method.description: Requests cancellation. The call completes with [constant GrpcClient.CANCELLED].

method.name: get_body
method.description: Returns the first response message (unary calls).

method.name: get_headers
method.description: Returns the response headers as a dictionary of arrays of strings.

method.name: get_messages
method.description: Returns all response messages as [PackedByteArray] values.

method.name: get_trailers
method.description: Returns the response trailers as a dictionary of arrays of strings.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether the call has completed.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns whether the call is still running.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts a call that was configured manually. [method GrpcClient.call_async] starts it automatically.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted on the main thread when the call completes.
